title: How to Automate Check-In Checklists and Finance for Short-Term Rental Properties
summary: See how to automate check-in checklists and finance for short-term rental properties with one internal system, no spreadsheets.
body_markdown:
To **automate check-in checklists and finance for short-term rental properties** means generating cleaning tasks automatically with every reservation and connecting approved expenses directly to the ERP, with no separate manual control for each property. In **Jestor** , both fronts live in the same system.


A poorly organized check-in generates guest complaints. Unchecked finances create losses that only show up when the month closes. Both problems tend to come from the same source: a lack of structured process.


Fixing this doesn't require switching channel managers, it requires an operational layer behind it.


## What Tends to Break Down Without Automation


- Cleaning checklists agreed on by message, with no record or confirmation
- No one knows, without asking, whether a property is ready for the next guest
- Restocking expenses get entered manually, with delays
- No visibility into how much each property cost that month until the spreadsheet closes


## How to Automate Both Fronts


1. Automatically generate a checklist task with every new reservation logged
2. Assign an owner and deadline for each checklist step (cleaning, inspection, restocking)
3. Link restocking expenses to a request form, with approval limits
4. Connect the approval to the ERP, for automatic posting once approved
5. Consolidate everything in a dashboard by property, showing checklist and finance together


Front How it gets automated


Check-in checklist Task generated automatically with every reservation


Inspection and cleaning Defined owner and deadline, with recorded confirmation


Restocking expenses Request with approval limits, no parallel manual control


Finance Automatic ERP posting after approval


## Why **Jestor** Solves This


- **Tasks** with subtasks generate the checklist automatically, with a deadline and owner per step
- **Approvals** workflows cover restocking and maintenance expenses with value-based limits
- Native integration with **Omie** and **Conta Azul** eliminates manual entry of approved expenses
- A single dashboard shows checklist and finance side by side, by property


## Frequently asked questions


**Is the checklist created manually for every reservation?** No, see at[jestor.com](https://www.jestor.com/?ref=blog.jestor.com) : **Jestor** can generate it automatically with every new reservation logged.


**Does this include syncing the reservation from Airbnb or Booking?** No, that sync stays with the channel manager already in use; **Jestor** organizes what happens afterward.


**Can you tell who confirmed that cleaning was done?** Yes, each checklist step has an owner and status, with a recorded history; see more at[jestor.com](https://www.jestor.com/?ref=blog.jestor.com) .


**Is property-level finance kept separate from the company's overall finance?** Yes, finance can be filtered and tracked by individual property.


Automating both fronts is what makes it possible to **automate check-in checklists and finance for short-term rental properties** without relying on a parallel spreadsheet.
